messages:
lina: Quick thread: alternative to single manifest/token for pins: propose a chained-delta pin format. Hot KV stores only a chain_head hash, deltas live in object store. Benefits: small hot index, cheap incremental updates. Thoughts?

omar: Looks promising. Resolver path: read chain_head -> consult in-memory manifest cache -> if miss, replay last N deltas or fetch snapshot. Keep replay small for latency.

devin: Agree on cache-first. Constraint: p99 serve latency must not spike. Enforce max_replay_for_hot_path = 1; deeper chains trigger async rebuilds.

sam: For rollout semantics (canaries/weights) keep routing separate: pin = artifact pointer + optional rollout_tag. Routing table maps rollout_tag -> weight config. That avoids embedding split logic in pins.

ops-maya: Migration: dual-write index entries for 2 weeks. Index value becomes additive JSON: {"manifest_url","chain_head","signature"}. Old clients read manifest_url; new resolvers prefer chain_head+cache.

lina: Security: sign chain_head with control-plane key. Resolver verifies signature before trusting chain. Use KMS-managed key + short key caching.

omar: Snapshots: periodically collapse long chains to snapshots (every N deltas) to bound replay cost. Store snapshot pointer as chain_head too.

devin: Observability: add metrics pin.chain_replay_latency, pin.cache_hit_rate, pin.snapshot_frequency. Also trace expanded-manifest fetches for Console debug.

ci-bot: snapshot created: control-plane/experiments/delta-pin/5932109876

ops-maya: Ops playbook: dual-write, enable on canary cluster, monitor replay latency and fallback rate (<0.2% target), run weekly snapshot job, then flip default.

lina: Action items: (1) prototype resolver chain-head read + cache (lina, 5d) (2) snapshot job + snapshotter (omar, 7d) (3) migration playbook doc (ops-maya, 3d). Review in Thursday sync.

sam: +1. make sure to include stress tests for chain replay under high QPS.

lina: Closing for now, PR incoming.
